content.short: Higlobe gives freelancers in emerging markets USD and EUR receiving accounts to get paid and cash out locally.
content.description: Higlobe is a cross-border payments service that helps freelancers, contractors and small businesses in markets like the Philippines, India, Brazil, Mexico and Colombia receive money from US, UK and EU clients. Users get a free USD or EUR receiving account, collect payments from employers and platforms, and withdraw to their local bank at competitive rates with near-instant transfers and no percentage fee. Registered as a money service business with FinCEN, Higlobe focuses on giving professionals who earn in dollars a low-cost way to keep more of each payment. It raised a 14 million dollar Series A to grow its receiving-account and payout network.
